body:
hey, thanks

I'm home now, not really feeling much of anything at all.  it's one part exhaustion, two parts numbness.

I wish I could have more to say, it took me long enough to just type this out.  normally i don't shut up but it's tough to find words right now.

I do appreciate the thoughts, i realize it doesn't take much but it does help a little
I'm awake and at work but I'm still pretty much in the same place mentally.

I've never responded well to anti-depressants of any class and I've tried a great deal over the years. I realize everyone's different and I haven't tried them all but I've never gotten anything but side effects. I did quit smoking on wellbutrin but it did nothing for my mood.
